messages:
rebecca: Heads-up team 1 short notice 1 we're rolling a brief resilience dry-run next week focused on embeddings endpoints + a small wording update to our SLO exceptions. Please scan and ack if anything blocks.

rebecca: Quick bullets:
- SLO tweak: temporarily tighten embeddings p99 from 700ms -> 600ms for canary pools during the test window to validate routing and kernel affinity changes. This is scoped and will not affect global production SLOs.
- Legal note: clarified maintenance exception language for scheduled failovers only. No change to uptime numbers. Internal memo: https://redwood.internal/legal/slo-exceptions-embed-2026

rebecca: Dry-run details:
- When: Mon Jul 18 2026 04:00 - 05:00 UTC
- Scope: controlled traffic replay hitting embeddings-heavy workloads in us-east-1 canaries + simulate draining one AZ to trigger routing fallback and KV-cache cold starts
- Expected impact: no planned customer downtime; canary latencies and 5xx may spike briefly. We'll pause promotions and disable auto-promote for the window.

omar: Confirming: this only tightens detection for canaries during the window, right? No immediate global enforcement?

rebecca: Correct 1 canary-only enforcement for the window. No auto-global rollback. It will hold promotions and open an incident for manual review.

kai: Monitoring plan 1 I'll spin up a short-lived dashboard with p50/p95/p99, embed-latency, kv-cache miss-rate, and routing fallback counts. Pager if embed p99 > 1s for 5m OR 5xx > 12% for 4m.

vivian: I'll prepare a short customer note for enterprise accounts and tag account leads. Also asking release owners to avoid promotions 03:30-05:30 UTC that day.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Embeddings resilience dry-run + SLO exception note" Mon Jul 18 04:00-05:00 UTC  invites: #eng-sre #eng-runtime #support #product-ops.

rebecca: Pre-check list for owners:
- verify canary pool tags and that promotion webhooks are disabled
- validate KV cache retention settings on canaries
- confirm alert hooks and rotation coverage for window
- ensure runbook links in PagerDuty incident

rebecca: Abort / quick commands to keep handy:
```
# stop replay fanout
kubectl scale deploy/embed-replay -n stress --replicas=0
# isolate canary pool routing
infractl routing set-weight --pool canary --weight 0
# clear canary kvcache warmups
infractl kvcache set-retention --pool canary --seconds 300
```

omar: Acked 1 I'll be on rotation that hour and can jump on incident channel if anything fires.

kai: :eyes: will post dashboard links ~20m prior.

vivian: Ack 1 drafting enterprise note and notifying release owners.

rebecca: Thanks. If no conflicts react with :white_check_mark:. We'll publish the legal memo to #all-hands tomorrow per legal's ask.

omar: :white_check_mark:

kai: :white_check_mark:

vivian: :white_check_mark:
